title: release-hold command payload

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command release-hold (connectors design §13.3): clears the holds of the source's documents kept by a rejected deletion; they become deletion candidates at the next reconcile. Dedup release-hold:{sourceId}.
